description: Fix three blockers that prevent a clean dev startup: (1) missing apps/api/.env, (2) requireOrgAccess double-wrap that silently skips org auth checks, (3) dead MUI deps that violate the Tailwind-only rule.
steps:
Create apps/api/.env with these exact values (both JWT secrets are 44 chars, satisfying min(32)):
  NODE_ENV=development
  PORT=4000
  WEB_URL=http://localhost:5173
  DATABASE_URL=postgresql://localhost:5432/llah_dev
  DIRECT_URL=postgresql://localhost:5432/llah_dev
  JWT_ACCESS_SECRET=dev_access_secret_change_in_production_aaaa
  JWT_REFRESH_SECRET=dev_refresh_secret_change_in_production_bbbb
  ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL=15m
  REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_DAYS=30
Edit apps/api/src/config/env.js — inside the z.object({...}) add: DIRECT_URL: z.string().min(1).optional()  (optional so it doesn't break if someone runs without it on managed Neon)
Create apps/web/.env.example with a single line: VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:4000/v1

Edit apps/api/src/middleware/rbac.js — fix requireOrgAccess: the current signature is `export function requireOrgAccess(req, res, next) { return async (req, res, next) => { ... }; }` which is a factory returning a middleware instead of being a middleware. Change it to `export async function requireOrgAccess(req, res, next) { try { ... } catch(error) { next(error); } }` — promote the inner async body directly, removing the outer wrapper and the inner arrow function. The body content (organizationId extraction, membership check, req.membership/req.organizationId assignment) stays identical.
Edit apps/web/package.json — remove from the dependencies object: @mui/material, @mui/icons-material, @emotion/react, @emotion/styled
Run: npm install (from the repo root c:\Users\Coding-Kimz\Desktop\crazy\llah) to regenerate node_modules and package-lock.json
acceptance_criteria: apps/api/.env exists and contains all 9 keys
apps/api/src/config/env.js parses successfully when loaded (DIRECT_URL field present in schema)
requireOrgAccess is a direct async function (req, res, next) not a function-returning-a-function
npm run build -w @llah/web exits 0 after npm install
verification: Run: npm run build -w @llah/web — must exit 0 with no errors
Run from apps/api: node --input-type=module -e "import('./src/config/env.js').then(m => console.log('env ok', m.env.PORT))" — must print 'env ok 4000'
